FN-ZQN17KR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 370
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Economic Development
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 03/18/2026
Senate Bill 370 as introduced would delay potential tax increases in ad valorem tax receipts
collected within certain tax increment districts (TIDs) to state and local governments as a result
of allowing: (1) public entities to be reimbursed from ad valorem tax revenues collected within
TIDs for costs to acquire land or interest in land forming a Major 21st Century Manufacturing
Authority prior to creation of a TID and (2) Major 21st Century Manufacturing Authorities to be
located within a TID regardless of the size of the TID.
